verdict.rationale: Casium makes only vague timing claims, such as "clear deadlines you can count on" and "moves your case forward fast". The H-1B guide gives the lottery-to-October-1 calendar, but nothing in the pack publishes Casium's own petition preparation time or government processing times for any visa type. Attorney response speed ("minutes and hours") is about communication, not case timelines, so it does not count.
